findings.highlight: Your body is as bad as Sakura’s
findings.evidenceJa: シロウの体だって、サクラと同じぐらい危ない
findings.governingReading: Illya says Shirou’s body is in as much danger as Sakura’s.
findings.explanation: The English replaces bodily danger with a vague negative comparison.

findings.highlight: I’m fine as long as the cloth is on
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと布を巻いてれば大事はない
findings.governingReading: Shirou claims there will be no serious trouble provided the cloth remains properly wrapped.
findings.explanation: The English turns a conditional claim about avoiding serious danger into general wellness.

findings.highlight: No way!
findings.evidenceJa: 何もなくないわっ！
findings.governingReading: Illya sharply rejects Shirou’s claim that nothing happened: it plainly was not nothing.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a generic exclamation for the logical rebuttal.

findings.highlight: It can’t be helped if that’s the case.
findings.evidenceJa: そりゃあ、イリヤに怒られるのもしょうがない
findings.governingReading: Shirou concludes that, given his expression, it is no wonder Illya scolded him.
findings.explanation: The English drops Illya, the scolding, and the causal conclusion.

findings.highlight: I had to think
findings.evidenceJa: つい考え込んじまった
findings.governingReading: Shirou admits that he fell into brooding despite knowing it would accomplish nothing.
findings.explanation: The English makes the brooding necessary or deliberate rather than inadvertent.

findings.highlight: I can’t empty my head
findings.evidenceJa: 空っぽのままじゃいられない
findings.governingReading: Shirou accepts that he cannot remain hollow or vacant.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the direction and says he cannot clear his mind.

findings.highlight: …Crap.
findings.evidenceJa: ……まいった
findings.governingReading: Shirou is disarmed or overcome by Illya’s sudden kindness.
findings.explanation: The English replaces his rueful surrender with a generic curse.

findings.highlight: she’s helped me when I’m feeling down
findings.evidenceJa: こっちがダメになっている時に手を引いてもらった
findings.governingReading: Illya has taken Shirou by the hand when he was becoming helpless or falling apart.
findings.explanation: The English weakens both his condition and the concrete caretaking image.

findings.highlight: Homunculus
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ホムンクルス char=4]人造人間
findings.governingReading: The surface text calls a homunculus an artificial human while the ruby supplies the technical term.
findings.explanation: The English retains only the ruby term and loses the explanatory written layer.

findings.highlight: are created with a powerful Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 稀に強大な魔術回路を持って誕生する
findings.governingReading: Homunculi are sometimes born with powerful Magic Circuits precisely because they differ from humans.
findings.explanation: The English removes the rarity, singularizes the circuits, and changes birth into manufacture.

findings.highlight: when they are made
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=うま o2o=1]作られる時
findings.governingReading: The written verb says made while its ruby asks the reader to hear born.
findings.explanation: The English preserves only manufacture and erases the deliberate made/born doubleness.

findings.highlight: it doesn’t matter what it’s made of as long as it has that special function
findings.evidenceJa: それだけに特化していれば、別に人間でなくても
findings.governingReading: If a vessel is specialized solely in collecting defeated Servants’ souls, it need not be human.
findings.explanation: The English shifts the condition from functional specialization to material composition and possession of a special function.

findings.highlight: more like retrieving them than collecting them
findings.evidenceJa: 回収っていうよりは帰還
findings.governingReading: Illya corrects collection to return: defeated Servants go back through the Grail that summoned them.
findings.explanation: Retrieving still describes the Grail acquiring them and loses the corrective return relation.

findings.highlight: I should have collected all of them
findings.evidenceJa: 本当ならみんなわたしが回収している
findings.governingReading: Under ordinary conditions Illya would be the one collecting all defeated Servants in the city.
findings.explanation: The English recasts the standing counterfactual arrangement as a past failure to have collected them.

findings.highlight: It took Caster and Lancer when I noticed
findings.evidenceJa: 気付いた時にはキャスターとランサーを取られてて
findings.governingReading: By the time Illya noticed, Caster and Lancer had already been taken from her.
findings.explanation: The English can place the taking at the moment of discovery and weakens the prior completion.

findings.highlight: lost its ‘shell’ called class
findings.evidenceJa: 純粋な“魂”となったサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: The Servant loses the class shell and becomes a pure soul.
findings.explanation: The English states the loss of the shell but omits the resulting pure-soul state.

findings.highlight: the soul of the container itself
findings.evidenceJa: “[ruby text=容れ物 char=2]聖杯”自体の魂
findings.governingReading: The written text names the Holy Grail while the ruby identifies it as the vessel or container.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the container reading and removes the Grail/container equation.

findings.highlight: You don’t need extra programs in there
findings.evidenceJa: そこに余分なプログラムは走らない
findings.governingReading: No extra program can run alongside the Grail’s completed function.
findings.explanation: The English turns computational impossibility into mere lack of need.

findings.highlight: Once I collect many Servants, I have to cut off my functions as a human being
findings.evidenceJa: それが多くなれば多くなるほど、制御の為に人間の機能をカットしていく
findings.governingReading: Illya cuts human functions progressively as the number of collected Servants rises.
findings.explanation: The English compresses the graded process into a threshold reached after collecting many.

findings.highlight: I can manage them
findings.evidenceJa: その分精密に魂を制御できる
findings.governingReading: Sacrificing energy used for the limbs permits correspondingly more precise control of the souls.
findings.explanation: The English omits the proportional gain in precision.

findings.highlight: if I use all the power I’ve used to construct my human form
findings.evidenceJa: 人格を形成している部分を全て演算に回せば
findings.governingReading: Illya can redirect every part that forms her personality into computation.
findings.explanation: The English invents expended power used to build a human form and removes the personality substrate being consumed.

findings.highlight: Sakura is forced to
findings.evidenceJa: 桜はただ書き換えられていくだけ
findings.governingReading: Sakura is progressively rewritten, without choice, as the black Grail takes over.
findings.explanation: The English preserves coercion but omits the replacement mechanism and its ongoing process.

findings.highlight: there’s no problem in me staying as myself
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤでいる事に支障はない
findings.governingReading: Illya says there is no obstacle to remaining “Illya,” using her characteristic third-person self-reference.
findings.explanation: The English normalizes the line into adult first-person phrasing and loses character voice.

findings.highlight: I don’t need to cut off my functions
findings.evidenceJa: 削る必要はないかな
findings.governingReading: Illya estimates that even absorbing Rider and Assassin probably would not require cutting human functions.
findings.explanation: The English removes her tentative estimate and states the outcome categorically.

findings.highlight: If I lose Illya as well
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤまで無くなってしまったら
findings.governingReading: Shirou fears Illya herself disappearing as her Grail function erases personhood.
findings.explanation: The English can read as death or personal loss and weakens the scene’s specific erasure mechanism.

findings.highlight: I just touch her, holding her in my arms
findings.evidenceJa: ただ触れるだけの、一方的な抱擁
findings.governingReading: The embrace is barely a touch and explicitly one-sided.
findings.explanation: The English retains gentle contact but omits that Illya does not reciprocate.

findings.highlight: what I must protect
findings.evidenceJa: 守り通さなくちゃいけないもの
findings.governingReading: Shirou makes himself feel the weight of what he must protect all the way through.
findings.explanation: The English loses the durative insistence on carrying protection through to the end.
